Flow around objects

A 2D fluid solver running in the browser. It uses the lattice Boltzmann method to compute flow around an aerofoil, square or cylinder in air or water, with live drag and lift coefficients, vortex shedding and pressure and vorticity fields. An educational model, not experimentally validated.
